description: Steel tonnage estimate for a single-span pitched portal frame building (span 15-30 m) before any design: total tonnes, kg per m2 of floor, a range, the weight by part (frames, gable posts, bracing, eave struts, purlins, side rails, plates and connections) and typical member sizes. Interpolated between complete finite-element designs and calibrated against published designs. Use for budgets, tenders and feasibility; a real design needs the actual loads and code.

bracing.description: Optional: tube (default, tension and compression) or tension-only rods.

ground_snow_kN_m2.description: Characteristic ground snow load sk, kN/m2 (0.5-2.0). Roof load = 0.8 sk.

length_m.description: Building length, m. Frames are at 6 m.

span_m.description: Clear span of the frames, m (15-30).

name: estimate_portal_frame_steel
title: Estimate the steel of a portal frame building
